properties.statement: Same session: mapped the PR's changed paths (git diff against origin/main) to the registered Artifacts by `location` in the committed export, with their sha256, to know which acceptances the design gate would require before recording the change; and wrote tools/toolsnaps from `reflow2-mcp --list-tools --full` through toolsnap.py's own update(), because toolsnap.py drives a temporary store in a folder that a build without RocksDB refuses.
